context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress packets of raw telemetry samples from devices
context_map.boundary_protection: Intake publishes a stable ingress contract; device-specific formats and internals do not enter the domain model; backpressure signals flow back to producers

context_map.exchanged_information: Validated and VALIDATION_FAILED-tagged samples with validation status
context_map.boundary_protection: Reconciliation consumes only published validation events and never re-evaluates Sensor Metric Boundaries, which Intake owns; eventual consistency

context_map.exchanged_information: Ordered samples and backfill detections that require new revisions
context_map.boundary_protection: Ledger receives ordered samples and backfill notices only; reorder-window buffering stays in Reconciliation; Ledger only appends revisions; eventual consistency

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Telemetry sample ingestion: device packet is validated, chronologically reconciled within the 60-second window, and appended to the ledger as a revision
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual across contexts; immediate within each. A sample may be validated but not yet ordered or stored briefly. Invalid samples are flagged, never dropped; failed appends must be retried.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Open questions: handling of samples later than the 60-second window; downstream broadcasting to analytics consumers is undescribed and treated as external (relationship from Ledger or Reconciliation to external undecided); validation-before-reordering assumed.
